question: Which country had topped the "World Happiness Index" report in the year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Finland**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Finland was the happiest country in the world in 2020, according to the World Happiness Report: **
 
• **Top 10 countries: Finland, Denmark, Switzerland, Iceland, Netherlands, Norway, Sweden, Luxembourg, New Zealand, and Austria **
 
• **Bottom 3 countries: Rwanda, Zimbabwe, and Afghanistan **
 
• **India's rank: 144 **
 
• The World Happiness Report is based on survey scores and answers to a main life evaluation question.
 
• The report measures the happiness and well-being of individuals in nations worldwide. 
 
 
• Factors that contribute to happiness include:
 
• A high quality of life
 
• Strong social support systems
 
• Low corruption
 
• A healthy work-life balance
 
• A strong sense of community
 
• A propensity for helping others
 
• A clear sense of purpose
 
• The rule of law
 
• Reduced inequality
 
• Public institution confidence
